scope.note: The final clean 0.8.7 source Skill package (64450b8) saved and freshly captured both exact synthetic drafts. Their bytes match earlier retained sample images, but new evidence binds each capture to its own full SHA and inputs. Historical preview HTTP readback, explicit stop and recovery readback passed. A separate real capture containing only a before/after pair was checked through the final package: older-draft details read the before-image, and its production renderer excludes the newer after-image. The same public package is installed locally with manifest integrity verified. Historical workbench screenshots remain labelled as historical. No private project data is shown.
